Camille R.: Postmortem follow-up from the 03/18 tail-latency event. Need to lock remediation owners, timelines, and decide SLO handling for the next 2 weeks.
Omar Z.: I can own autoscale + alert changes. Plan: add a short burst counter, shorten scale-up cooldown, and add a staging alert for the buffered SLO. ETA 48h.
Priya S.: Ill take runtime (KV eviction + hotspot detection). ETA 72h for a staged fix and perf run.
Camille R.: Proposal: do NOT change the public SLO. Create an internal "buffered p95" = 280ms for ops/error-budget math for 14 days and annotate the public dashboard with the incident window. Keeps customer SLAs intact.
Omar Z.: Sounds good. Ill push a staging alert:
```
alert: BufferedP95Ops
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspot"}
```
Ill update staging dashboards and leave public alerts unchanged.
Priya S.: Ill add shard-level metrics and trace annotations in my PR. Running perf test after changes.
OncallBot: Incident 2026-03-18 | estimated error-budget impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | runbook: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Camille R.: Action items: Priya -> runtime PR + perf job (3d), Omar -> autoscale + staging alert + dashboards (2d), Camille -> canary plan + rollback criteria (1d). Add ETAs to the postmortem ticket and tag @oncall for rollout window.
Priya S.: Draft PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/1935 - includes eviction tweak and hotspot metrics. Perf job shows ~18% tail improvement.
Omar Z.: Infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1284 - adds burst counter and cooldown change. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/p95-buffered. Canary ready after runtime merges.
Camille R.: Canary checklist: 1) update internal SLO docs, 2) canary = 5% traffic, 3) rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m OR error-rate delta > 0.5%. Scheduling tentative canary 10:00 UTC tomorrow.
Priya S.: No blockers. Will finalize patch in the morning.
Omar Z.: Ill notify CS and SRE about the dashboard annotation and canary timing.
Camille R.: Thanks all. Well reconvene after canary to decide whether to keep the buffered SLO for the 14-day window or restore original thresholds. Logging closure items in the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
